QUOTE: "Define the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` macro in the module's public header under `include/mbedtls/`" and "Do not edit the generated arms directly."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gets "header plus regenerate, don't hand-edit error.c", but it never says the `/** */` doc comment on the `#define` is the string's source. It adds a separate step to put the description in the generator's data files and admits it doesn't know where the strings live. That is a different mechanism from the one the item names.
